import pandas as pd

df=pd.read_csv('benchmark/data.csv')
df['Date']=pd.to_datetime(df['Date'])
df=df.sort_values('Date').reset_index(drop=True)

tmp=df.copy()
tmp['Year']=tmp['Date'].dt.year
tmp['Decade']=(tmp['Year']//10)*10

# avoid deprecated groupby.apply behavior: groupby on Decade then use agg and idxmin/idxmax via loc within group

def min_month(g):
    i=g['Crude_Oil_Price'].astype(float).idxmin()
    return df.loc[i,'Date']

def max_month(g):
    i=g['Crude_Oil_Price'].astype(float).idxmax()
    return df.loc[i,'Date']

out=(tmp.groupby('Decade')
       .agg(Months=('Crude_Oil_Price','size'),
            Mean=('Crude_Oil_Price','mean'),
            Median=('Crude_Oil_Price','median'),
            StdDev=('Crude_Oil_Price',lambda s: s.std(ddof=1)),
            Min=('Crude_Oil_Price','min'),
            Max=('Crude_Oil_Price','max'))
     )

# add dates
out=out.reset_index()
out['Period']=out['Decade'].astype(int).astype(str)+'s'
# compute min/max month per decade
min_dates=[]; max_dates=[]
for d in out['Decade']:
    g=tmp[tmp['Decade']==d]
    min_dates.append(min_month(g))
    max_dates.append(max_month(g))
out['MinMonth']=min_dates
out['MaxMonth']=max_dates
print(out[['Period','Months','Mean','StdDev','Min','MinMonth','Max','MaxMonth']])
